rows.title: The Billionaire's Fake Wife
rows.description: Lily Chen never wanted to be a thief. But when her father threatens her life unless she steals corporate secrets from billionaire David Kim, she has no choice.

messages: Breaking into his Manhattan penthouse should have been simple—until David catches her in the act.

Instead of turning her over to the police, he offers a deal: help him expose her father's criminal empire, and he'll protect her. But there's a catch—they have to pretend to be married to make it convincing.

As they work together to bring down a dangerous man, their forced alliance ignites into something neither expected. Late nights planning their next move turn into stolen kisses. Fake touches for the cameras become all too real.
But with her father's threats escalating and David's empire at risk, Lily must decide: betray the man she's falling for, or risk everything for a chance at redemption and love.
